title: Dangerous Goods Acceptance: Amendment Fees and the Re-review Fee for a Change of Sailing
content:
## Amendment fee

Under Dangerous Goods Acceptance an amendment costs nothing while the number of signed amendments already counted on the acceptance is below the category's free allowance; any amendment beyond that is charged the category's amendment fee, and the charge refers to the amendment submission concerned.

**Hypothetical illustration (free allowance of 1).**

| Signed amendments already counted | Below the allowance? | Amendment now handled |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | yes | free |
| 1 | no | charged the amendment fee |
| 2 | no | charged the amendment fee |

## Re-review fee on a change of sailing

Where the booking is moved to another sailing and the category reopens approvals on such a move, an approved acceptance goes back to review and bears the category's re-review fee a single time for that change of sailing. That charge is entered without any submission reference.

## Window for booking these fees

The earlier provision that confined amendment fees and re-review fees alike to acceptances standing as submitted, under review or approved is **no longer in force**; the current basis on when these fees may be booked replaces it.

## Points of judgement

**What brings the re-review fee about?** The move of the booking to another sailing, in a category whose approvals reopen on such a move, applied to an acceptance that stood approved; the approval reopens and the fee is charged once for that move.

**Which amendments count towards the free allowance?** Signed amendments of the acceptance counted up to the amendment being handled; the one being handled is judged against that count.

superseded_clauses: Amendment and re-review fees may be booked only while the acceptance is submitted, under_review or approved.
